name: mail-adagio
description: Sorts Gmail: gives each mail one theme and one status, using an AI model you choose. Never deletes mail.
status: Step 3: sorts the inbox by batches (labels + out of the Inbox), with approval, undo and resume.
how_to_call: python adagio.py call   (one JSON request on stdin, one JSON result on stdout)

input.action: check | hardware | preview | estimate | plan | apply | discard | undo | status | correct | rules | delete_rule
input.batch_size: estimate/plan: mails per batch, 50 to 1000 (default from config)
input.act_alone: plan: true = apply the batch right away (default from config)
input.restart: plan: true = start again from the newest mail
input.batch_id: apply: the plan to carry out
input.skip: apply: [gm_msgid] to leave as they are
input.since_days: preview: only mails from the last N days (optional)
input.correct: {gm_msgid, sender, subject, theme, status, remember: none|sender|domain}

output.plan: {plan: {batch_id, processed, by_theme, by_status, fallbacks, labels, mails: [{gm_msgid, date, sender, subject, theme, status, rule, state}]}, progress: {done, total, batch_no, batches, finished}}
output.status: {progress, plan, last, act_alone, batch_size, archive, labels}

never: store mail content (only id, date, sender, subject and tags)
